scope: Optional genuine CLI inference while retaining the default native HTTP relay

real_provider.path: Responses facade -> genuine CLI -> private loopback forwarder -> existing Han HTTP relay -> provider

discovered_and_fixed.before: Provider completed with200, but Responses facade returned502 unsupported_upstream_event
discovered_and_fixed.cause: Nullable official context_management metadata was outside the adapter contract
discovered_and_fixed.after: Nullable and documented applied-edit observations are retained as metadata

discovered_and_fixed.before: Real tool intent returned200, but function_call_output continuation returned409 cli_session_history_mismatch
discovered_and_fixed.cause: Responses omits literal direct-caller and null-toolset defaults retained in native session history
discovered_and_fixed.after: Both history paths normalize equivalent defaults while retaining content, substantive metadata and signatures

discovered_and_fixed.before: A connected nonreading client could leave a backpressured write waiting past cancellation
discovered_and_fixed.after: Abort interrupts the write wait and finalizes owned work without another blocked error write

intermediate_controller_limit: One pre-final HTTP200-shaped response was followed by a local error:null parsing exception; its expected reply was not counted as verified. The final-image three-request workflow independently passed.
compose_validation: docker compose config --quiet passed with synthetic environment values
remaining_limits: CLI state lives in active workers; no arbitrary old-history hydration or restart recovery
Compaction, branching and changed prefixes may require a fresh session
Actual provider signed-thinking replay was not exercised by the simple Haiku prompts
Credential turnover was verified synthetically; actual account expiry during a CLI tool conversation was not tested
Production Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode qualification through LiteLLM remains pending for this backend
Large MCP output may be normalized, shortened or spilled by the official CLI
Forced tools, sampling overrides, stop sequences and count_tokens require the HTTP backend
Explicit thinking display updates is supported by HTTP, not the pinned SDK option contract
Existing generic HTTP upstream429 behavior is not claimed fixed
